title: UFO Moviez Divests 90% Stake in Wholly Owned Subsidiary Upmarch Media
description: UFO Moviez India Limited's Board of Directors has approved the disinvestment of a 90% stake in its wholly owned subsidiary, Upmarch Media Network Private Limited, to Dr. Sunil Patil. The transaction, approved on August 19, 2026, involves transferring 180,000 shares at a face value of ₹10 each, aggregating to ₹18 lacs. UFO Moviez will retain a 10% stake. Upmarch, incorporated in August 2023, has had no business operations to date. The sale is expected to be completed by September 18, 2026. This is not a related party transaction, and Upmarch will cease to be a subsidiary post-completion. The net worth of Upmarch as of March 31, 2026, was ₹17.61 lacs, representing 0.05% of UFO Moviez's consolidated net worth.

title: Pentagon UFO scientist Dr Eric Davis claims US has evidence of 4 alien species after 30 years of UAP research: ‘I’ve seen the evidence, I’ve seen the records’
description: Pentagon-linked astrophysicist Dr Eric Davis claims he has seen classified records and evidence allegedly documenting four different alien species recovered from crashed UAPs. The alleged beings include Grays, Nordics, Insectoids and Reptilians. Davis, who says he investigated UAPs for 30 years, has urged President Donald Trump to protect whistleblowers and allow greater disclosure.
